description: Defines data models related to chat functionality, including message contents, sessions, history, and attachments within the ai.openclaw.app.chat package.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with id, role, content list, and optional timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content of a chat message, supporting different media types and text.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Models a pending or ongoing tool call within the chat, with identification and timing info.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a chat session key, last updated time, and optional display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Encapsulates the message history within a specific chat session.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment to be sent with a message, including media type, filename, and base64 content.
